fact: A few days before the close of the RGPH-3 count, the national coordinator for nomadic populations found in Batha that no enumerator had yet reached one herder camp and ordered a team sent; enumeration was still under way.
Decree no. 2087 of 20 July 2026 extended the RGPH-3 main enumeration to 6 August 2026 from the period set by the 11 May 2026 decree, to finish the count nationwide.
Decree no. 2087/PR/PM/MFBEPCI/2026 of 20 July 2026 extended the RGPH-3 main enumeration, first set for 21 June to 21 July 2026, to 6 August 2026 to sweep uncovered areas and complete the count.

Joint order no. 070/2026 of 6 May 2026, under decree 0538/2025 of 2 April 2025, set up provincial, departmental and sub-prefectoral commissions for RGPH-3; they are dissolved after final results are published.

The World Bank resident representative said the Bank finances Chad's national statistical system with US$105 million through PHASAOC, more than a third of it for the third population and housing census (RGPH-3) and for human resources.

INSEED states that collection operations of the third general population and housing census (RGPH-3) officially ended on 6 August 2026, the country's first fully digital census (news item dated 7 August 2026).
